A direct verse warning works because it names forgetting plainly; for SalaLam it maps to the morning version of forgetting, where the phone comes first and prayer slips.
A comfort verse is useful for restart content: it lowers the shame of a missed week, which is exactly the audience a streak-based Fajr alarm needs to re-engage.

Friday framing plus everyday kindness shows occasion content can still point at personal consistency; for SalaLam the bridge is keeping a promise to yourself at Fajr, not only to others.
